title: CustomTypeMembershipCompact
description: This object describes a user or team's membership to a custom type including their level of access (Admin, Editor, User, or Viewer).

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

parent.description: The custom type the user or team is a member of.

member.description: Member can be a user or a team.

access_level.description: Whether the member has admin, editor, user, or viewer access to the custom type.
